section.p: Local version 1.2.0 requires DITA-OT 4.4.2 or newer and Java 17 or newer. Runtime verification uses DITA-OT 4.4.2 with Java 25. Newer toolkits require fresh verification.
The Maven build uses the DOST 4.3.0 API artifact because this is the latest API artifact available on Maven Central. The runtime distribution tested is 4.4.2.
Install the standalone plug-in ZIP into a chosen toolkit. Oxygen integration and custom host frameworks have not been tested as part of this local build.
